chapterInfo.content:
25
Nyansa so akatua
1Yei nso ne Salomo mmebusɛm bi a Yudahene Hesekia nnipa fa twerɛeɛ.
2Nyankopɔn animuonyam ne asɛm so kata,
na ahemfo animuonyam ne asɛm mu hwehwɛ.
3Ɔsoro ware a ɛwareɛ, ne asase mu dɔ a ɛdɔ,
ne ahemfo akoma mu nni hwehwɛbea.
4Yi fi dwetɛ mu,
na agudeɛ firi odwumfoɔ nsam aba.
5 # Mmb 16.12 Yi ɔbɔnefoɔ firi ɔhene anim,
na n’ahennwa bɛtim tenenee mu.
6Nhyehyɛ wo ho ɔhene anim,
na nkɔgyina nnipa akɛseɛ gyinabea.
7 # Luk 14.7-11 Na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Bra soro ha!
sene sɛ wɔbɛbrɛ wo aseɛ ɔberempɔn
a w’ani ahu no no anim.
8Mfiri hatuhatu nkɔko,
na ɛbɛwie akyire yi no, wobɛyɛ dɛn,
sɛ wo yɔnko de wo ato aniwuo mu?
9 # Mmb 20.19 Asɛm a wo ne wo yɔnko wɔ no, wo ne no nni,
na nyi obi ahuntasɛm adi;
10na deɛ ɔbɛteɛ no annidi wo atɛm,
na wo nsopa anka hɔ.
11 # Mmb 15.23 Asɛm a wɔka a ɛfata
te sɛ sika aduaba wɔ dwetɛ nkɛntɛn mu.
12Sɛdeɛ sika asomuadeɛ ne amapa ahyehyɛdeɛ teɛ no,
saa na onimkafoɔ nyansafoɔ teɛ wɔ aso a ɛte asɛm soɔ.
13Sɛdeɛ sukyerɛmma dwoɔ teɛ twaberɛ mu no,
saa na ɔbɔfoɔ nokwafoɔ teɛ ma wɔn a wɔsomaa no,
na ɔdwodwo ne wuranom kra.
14 # 2 Pe 2.17 Deɛ ɔde akyɛdeɛ a ɔmmaeɛ hoahoa ne ho no
te sɛ mununkum ne mframa a osuo nni mu.
15 # Mmb 15.1 Abodwokyɛre dane ɔtemmufoɔ ti,
na tɛkyerɛmabereɛ bu dompe mu.
16Wohunu ɛwoɔ a, di deɛ ɛso woɔ,
na amfono wo, na woamfe angu.
17Mma wo nan nnyɛ wo yɔnko fie ntiantia,
na wo ho anyɛ no mfone na wantane wo.
18 # Mmb 19.5 Asabaa ne nkrantɛ ne agyan nnamnnam
ne onipa a ɔdi ne yɔnko ho adansekurumu.
19Ɔkɔnkɔnsani so anidasoɔ, hiada mu,
te sɛ ɛse a abuo ne nan a afirikyie.
20Deɛ ɔto dwom kyerɛ ɔwerɛhoni no
te sɛ deɛ ɔpa ntoma awɔberɛ mu,
anaa nsa kekakeka a wɔde gu dɔw soɔ.
21 # Rom 12.20; Mat 5.44 Sɛ ɛkɔm de wo tamfo a, ma no aduane nni,
na sukɔm de no a, ma no nsuo nnom;
22na wobɛso nsramma agu n’atifi,
na AWURADE bɛhyɛ wo ananmu.
23Atifi fam mframa de osuo ba,
saa ara nso na ntwirie tɛkyerɛma de abufunimu ba.
24 # Mmb 21.9, 19 Ɛdan atifi kokoam tena yɛ
sene sɛ wo ne ɔbaa tɔkwapɛfoɔ bɛtena ɛdan mu.
25Sɛdeɛ nsuonwunu yɛ ɔkra a atɔ piti no,
sɛ asɛmpa a ɛfiri akyirikyiri asase soɔ yɛ ne no.
26Sɛdeɛ nsuo aniwa a wɔatiatia mu ne abura a wɔasɛeɛ no teɛ no,
saa na ɔteneneeni a ɔtɔ ɔbɔnefoɔ anim ntintan teɛ.
27Ɛwoɔdie ntrasoɔ nyɛ,
enti animuonyam a nnipa pɛ ma wɔn ho nyɛ animuonyam.
28 # Mmb 29.11 Onipa a ɔntumi nhyɛ ne ho so no
te sɛ kuro a abubuo a afasuo nni ho.

Yei nso ne Salomo mmebusɛm bi a Yudahene Hesekia nnipa fa twerɛeɛ.
Nyankopɔn animuonyam ne asɛm so kata,
na ahemfo animuonyam ne asɛm mu hwehwɛ.
Ɔsoro ware a ɛwareɛ, ne asase mu dɔ a ɛdɔ,
ne ahemfo akoma mu nni hwehwɛbea.
Yi fi dwetɛ mu,
na agudeɛ firi odwumfoɔ nsam aba.
Yi ɔbɔnefoɔ firi ɔhene anim,
na n’ahennwa bɛtim tenenee mu.
Nhyehyɛ wo ho ɔhene anim,
na nkɔgyina nnipa akɛseɛ gyinabea.
Na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔka kyerɛ wo sɛ: Bra soro ha!
sene sɛ wɔbɛbrɛ wo aseɛ ɔberempɔn
a w’ani ahu no no anim.
Mfiri hatuhatu nkɔko,
na ɛbɛwie akyire yi no, wobɛyɛ dɛn,
sɛ wo yɔnko de wo ato aniwuo mu?
Asɛm a wo ne wo yɔnko wɔ no, wo ne no nni,
na nyi obi ahuntasɛm adi;
na deɛ ɔbɛteɛ no annidi wo atɛm,
na wo nsopa anka hɔ.
Asɛm a wɔka a ɛfata
te sɛ sika aduaba wɔ dwetɛ nkɛntɛn mu.
Sɛdeɛ sika asomuadeɛ ne amapa ahyehyɛdeɛ teɛ no,
saa na onimkafoɔ nyansafoɔ teɛ wɔ aso a ɛte asɛm soɔ.
Sɛdeɛ sukyerɛmma dwoɔ teɛ twaberɛ mu no,
saa na ɔbɔfoɔ nokwafoɔ teɛ ma wɔn a wɔsomaa no,

Deɛ ɔde akyɛdeɛ a ɔmmaeɛ hoahoa ne ho no
te sɛ mununkum ne mframa a osuo nni mu.
Abodwokyɛre dane ɔtemmufoɔ ti,
na tɛkyerɛmabereɛ bu dompe mu.
Wohunu ɛwoɔ a, di deɛ ɛso woɔ,
na amfono wo, na woamfe angu.
Mma wo nan nnyɛ wo yɔnko fie ntiantia,
na wo ho anyɛ no mfone na wantane wo.
Asabaa ne nkrantɛ ne agyan nnamnnam
ne onipa a ɔdi ne yɔnko ho adansekurumu.
Ɔkɔnkɔnsani so anidasoɔ, hiada mu,
te sɛ ɛse a abuo ne nan a afirikyie.
Deɛ ɔto dwom kyerɛ ɔwerɛhoni no
te sɛ deɛ ɔpa ntoma awɔberɛ mu,
anaa nsa kekakeka a wɔde gu dɔw soɔ.
Sɛ ɛkɔm de wo tamfo a, ma no aduane nni,
na sukɔm de no a, ma no nsuo nnom;
na wobɛso nsramma agu n’atifi,
na AWURADE bɛhyɛ wo ananmu.
Atifi fam mframa de osuo ba,
saa ara nso na ntwirie tɛkyerɛma de abufunimu ba.
Ɛdan atifi kokoam tena yɛ
sene sɛ wo ne ɔbaa tɔkwapɛfoɔ bɛtena ɛdan mu.
Sɛdeɛ nsuonwunu yɛ ɔkra a atɔ piti no,

Sɛdeɛ nsuo aniwa a wɔatiatia mu ne abura a wɔasɛeɛ no teɛ no,
saa na ɔteneneeni a ɔtɔ ɔbɔnefoɔ anim ntintan teɛ.
Ɛwoɔdie ntrasoɔ nyɛ,
enti animuonyam a nnipa pɛ ma wɔn ho nyɛ animuonyam.
Onipa a ɔntumi nhyɛ ne ho so no
te sɛ kuro a abubuo a afasuo nni ho.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
